question: Does an independently fitted rank-one resid18 is/was circuit transfer causally across construction and a second agent lexicon while sparing same-answer controls?

novelty_search.nearest_positive: The frozen has/had q transfers partially to is/was on two populations, but no is/was direction has been fitted or tested.
novelty_search.new_question: Identify the is/was direction independently so reciprocal transfer back to has/had can distinguish shared writer from one-way sensitivity.
novelty_search.anti_rank_drift: Rank one is frozen because the causal hypothesis is a shared scalar writer; a null is not permission to raise rank. This is task-conditioned causal identification, not compression.

frozen_design.fit: First eight v2 A1 rows only; 300 final-head-only Adam steps targeting each donor is/was margin.
frozen_design.next_if_screen: Freeze q_iswas and test it without refitting on has/had A/P/C panels in both directions.
frozen_design.rank_policy: Do not increase rank after a null.

predictions.pred_a_authority_head_and_rank: All hashes and capability screens pass, exact head <=1e-3, and q shape is 1152x1.
predictions.pred_d_prospective_construction_transfer: v3 A1 and A2 absolute recovery each >=0.50.
predictions.pred_f_exact_coverage: At most 19 forwards/264 examples, 300 head-only steps, 1152 fit scalars, no transformer backward or model update.

terminal.screen: A-F pass: identify an independent is/was rank-one carrier for reciprocal testing.
terminal.null: Valid rank-one test misses recovery/selectivity; do not raise rank.
terminal.invalid: Authority, capability, head, rank, or coverage failure.
